title: Stock Market Sell-Off: Is This the Best Stock to Buy Right Now During the Crash?
creator: Parkevtate Vosianc CFA
source_note: Detailed summary generated from video captions.
summary: Parkevtate argues Meta Platforms is the best stock to buy in the sell-off, after falling from a $780 high earlier this year to about $590. The family of apps (Facebook, Instagram, Messenger, Threads) has 3.64 billion daily users with engagement at record highs, helped by AI-improved content matching, and Threads has overtaken X in monthly active users. The most exciting development is the Meta Muse personal agent: over 10 million people in the US and Canada set it up in about six weeks, and it was the number one app in the App Store almost every day in late October. Zuckerberg expects it to reach billions of users, and monetisation should come from an 8% take rate on commerce done through Muse plus paid tiers for advanced features, while compute costs are expected to improve more than 10x. His earnings growth estimate is about 25% a year versus about 19% on the Street, at a forward PE of 16.7x, and his DCF fair value is $892. The catch is cash flow: free cash flow stays negative at about minus $50bn next year and minus $14bn the year after, turning positive only in 2029 at $51bn. Call: META BUY reiterated (prior BUY 12 Nov) - 'the best stock you can buy right now'. He owns it as one of his largest positions and is adding more. The video closes with a plug for his book on his six-step investing framework.

calls.base_case: Muse converts the 3.75bn-user distribution into a commerce/subscription business; compute costs fall 10x+ and FCF inflects in 2029.
calls.bull_case: Muse monetises fast (8% commerce take rate + paid tiers); EPS compounds ~25%/yr and the stock closes the gap to $892.
calls.bear_case: FCF stays deeply negative (-$50bn next year) while capex keeps rising; Muse monetisation is slower than hoped and the market keeps discounting the spend.
